question: Should OpenClaw permanently support `mcp.servers.*.oauth.authProfileId` as a higher-precedence credential source and allow its current access token in local Codex thread configuration?
rationale: The existing `openclaw mcp login` projection bug can be fixed without the alternate public selector, and literal local bearer materialization is a durable security boundary that implementation correctness alone cannot approve.

options.title: Accept both sources
options.body: Keep MCP-native OAuth as the default, retain `oauth.authProfileId` as the explicit higher-precedence source, and accept local-only bearer projection with remote fail-closed behavior.

options.title: Narrow to native OAuth
options.body: Remove the new auth-profile selector and land only projection of credentials created by `openclaw mcp login`.

options.title: Pause the change
options.body: Defer the PR if current access tokens must not be materialized into local Codex thread configuration.

recommendation.title: Accept both sources
recommendation.body: Keep MCP-native OAuth as the default, retain `oauth.authProfileId` as the explicit higher-precedence source, and accept local-only bearer projection with remote fail-closed behavior.
